sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 4 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 40% damage reflection for 40 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Heals 20% of max HP every 5 seconds for 40 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the Cost recovery speed of all allies for 40 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases fire, water, wind, light, and, dark elemental attack for all allies by 2 for 60 seconds
